citation: 405 for a method the endpoint does not support — RFC 9110 §15.5.6 (405; response MUST carry Allow); module 06 §5.1; { error, message } shape echoing method + path (§5.1). Router pairs this body with an Allow header.
notes: Routing: known path, wrong verb (here POST to a GET-only collection).
